body.statement: The compatible refinement class is finite and can be enumerated from the labelled input, with \(|\mathfrak R(H)|\le 2^{3n(n-1)/2}\); every enumerated graph carries a topological ordering certificate for its directed part and an exact coarsening certificate.
body.justification: Finiteness turns arbitrary clustering into a finite union problem without confusing a cyclic quotient with a cyclic micrograph.
body.gap: AnandRibeiroTianBareinboim2023CDAG assumes an acyclic cluster graph, while FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG allows cyclic quotients but does not enumerate exact known-size refinements for global identification.
body.consumer: It supplies the finite input family for the Global-CID search and its explicit complexity accounting.
